air_features: exact ridge raw air lags 0/1/2/3/5/7/14 and annual sine/cosine
flow_features: log1p discharge lags 0/1/3/7; missing on any hidden day means unavailable
model: MSE HistGradientBoosting, 200 iterations, 31 leaves, L2=1; fixed budget, no target tuning
neural_scope: global models use local climatology but no local water-air coefficient refit; this local nonlinear comparator is separate
scope: same target-station history as local ridge, except the complete held year is excluded from all training labels
test: identical saved neural test cases and masks; air-tier is the fair information comparison
